generation_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent orbital defense station sprite for the dark sci-fi strategy game Stellar Syndicates.
Input image 1 is the approved five-level station lineup, provided only as the authoritative family design, camera, lighting and material reference. Draw ONE new station, the GUN PLATFORM: the crude first rung that comes BEFORE the leftmost station in Image 1, the DEFENSE PLATFORM, and is later rebuilt into it. Same family, same camera, same light, same materials and rendering as Image 1. Do not reproduce the lineup.
DESIGN: a crude field-built orbital gun, bolted together by new colonists from spare alloy girders and mining machinery right after their first pirate raid. At its centre the SAME hexagonal core with the round cyan-lit reactor eye on top as the Defense Platform, but bare: no armored hull, no armored collar. Around the core an open, flat hexagonal frame of exposed charcoal girders and cross-bracing, with only a few mismatched pale titanium patch plates bolted on, so empty space shows through the gaps. Exactly ONE salvaged single-barrel cannon (one barrel, not twin) on a simple open ring mount, bolted to the frame just forward of the eye, its barrel pointing toward the viewer. Two strapped-on cylindrical tanks on the two rear corners, two flat bolted-on radiator panels on the sides, loose cable runs along the girders, two small work lights. No point-defense nodes, no radiator fins, no towers, no other weapons. Lower and plainer than the Defense Platform: clearly its cheaper, rougher predecessor, yet built around the same core.
CAMERA: exactly Image 1's camera: elevated three-quarter top-down view, about 40 degrees pitch, front edge toward the viewer, light from the upper left, soft neutral illumination, no harsh shadows.
FRAMING: square 1:1 canvas, 2048 by 2048 pixels. The whole station centred and fully visible, about 88% of the canvas width, every barrel tip, tank and panel inside an even empty margin.
STYLE: precise colored hard-surface 3D game concept rendering, clean contours, fine panel lines, pale silver titanium, charcoal gunmetal girders, restrained brass bolts and clamps, small cyan lights. More wear than the Defense Platform: weld seams, scuffed and mismatched plates. A bold silhouette that reads from above at 64 px.
Actual transparent background with real alpha, including the empty gaps in the open frame. No starfield, no star, no planet, no other stations or ships, no weapons fire, no beams, no glow halos, no cast shadow, no text, no labels, no logos, no watermark.
refinement_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent GUN PLATFORM orbital defense station sprite for Stellar Syndicates, square 2048 x 2048 pixel PNG.
Input image 1 is the edit target, the new Gun Platform sprite. Input image 2 is the approved lineup, used only as a style/camera reference and reference for the cyan reactor eye.
Make ONE narrowly targeted design correction to Image 1: strip the central hexagonal reactor core of its outer armor. It is currently clad in large sloping pale titanium petal armor and sits inside a thick pale hexagonal armored collar; REMOVE those outer armor petals and REMOVE that surrounding armored collar entirely. The central reactor must be BARE: a compact low charcoal hexagonal mechanical casing with exposed ribs, bolts, wiring and a few tiny mismatched service plates, still bearing the SAME round cyan-lit reactor eye on top with the same diameter, position and recognizable ring. Keep the reactor low and squat. The reactor's inner dark hexagonal machinery is allowed; an armored outer hull or continuous silver armored collar is not. It must look like this core has not yet received the armor it gains when upgraded into the leftmost Defense Platform in Image 2.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE in Image 1: identical outer silhouette and framing, same exposed charcoal hexagonal girders and cross-bracing with transparent holes, the same few weathered titanium patch plates, exact same ONE salvaged single-barrel cannon in its simple open ring mount forward of the eye with the barrel pointing toward the viewer, exact same TWO strapped-on cylindrical tanks on the two rear corners, exact same TWO flat bolted-on radiator panels on the sides, loose cable runs, restrained brass bolts and clamps, exactly TWO small work lights. Do not change the cannon ring. Do not add weapons, point-defense nodes, towers or radiator fins.
Preserve the precise colored hard-surface 3D game concept rendering, clean contours, fine panel lines, weld seams and scuffs, neutral soft upper-left illumination, no harsh shadows, elevated three-quarter top-down camera about 40 degrees pitch, front edge toward viewer.
Square 1:1 canvas at 2048 by 2048 pixels, entire station centered about 88% of canvas width with an even empty margin around all tips, panels and tanks.
Real transparent alpha background and genuinely transparent holes in open frame. Solid machinery stays opaque. No cast shadow, starfield, star, planet, other station or ship, weapons fire, beams, glow halo, text, labels, logo or watermark.
export: Crop only empty padding to the alpha > 8 content bounds plus a 2 px antialiasing guard; Lanczos-3 resample to approximately 88% of the 2048 px canvas width, centered with transparent padding. Preserve generated RGBA, including open frame gaps.
